changed_input_blocker.command_list_needed: Exact validator/prereq command for the next changed package or candidate artifact.
changed_input_blocker.expected_output_schema: Agent4 proof packet with changed_input_artifact, validator_commands including timeout_ms/result, counts, exact blockers, handoff_owner, stop_condition, and non_acceptance_boundary.
changed_input_blocker.validator_gate: Run only an existing named validator for the selected changed package/input, then validate the Agent4 packet with scripts/validate_agent4_validator_prereq_packet.mjs.
changed_input_blocker.package_owner: Agent 10 release/package intake or the upstream package-producing agent for the next changed artifact.
changed_input_blocker.agent6_boundary_trigger: Only after a concrete boundary-ready packet exists and Agent 6 review is explicitly needed.
changed_input_blocker.stop_condition: Stop after selecting one changed package/input or returning this exact blocker.

exact_blockers.details: No changed package/input candidate was selected after the provided anchor.

handoff_owner: Agent 4 for changed-input-only validation discipline; Agent 10 or upstream package owner must provide the next changed package/input.
stop_condition: Stop after returning an exact changed-input blocker.
non_acceptance_boundary: No source, provenance, license, legal, Definition, answer, product, publication, public/runtime, route publication, or release acceptance.
No accepted gloss, accepted text, public reader output, public runtime mutation, or release action.
